# Onyx

> Onyx is a CMMC Level 1 readiness service for small Department of Defense subcontractors in Virginia that handle Federal Contract Information (FCI). Onyx writes the written policies, builds an evidence binder for the 15 basic safeguarding requirements of FAR 52.204-21, and walks the company's senior official through the CMMC Level 1 affirmation in SPRS. Onyx handles the written side; the client's IT person or provider stays responsible for the technical side. Onyx does not issue certifications. Onyx is a trade name of ETaye LLC, run by Ezra Taye in Arlington, VA.

Fixed prices: readiness check $495 (credited toward setup); Level 1 setup $3,500 for 1-10 people or $4,500 for 11-25 people (about 21 days); yearly renewal $750/year.

Contact: Ezra Taye, 703-300-2469, ezra@onyxcmmc.com. Free 20-minute fit check: https://calendar.app.google/ubBg99S3piYL8Ur68
